historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (9-10%) is roughly half the revenue CAGR (19-20%) and EPS 5-year CAGR is negative (-8.3%; FY2020 was a COVID profit peak of RMB5.4bn). Revenue doubled through low-margin assembly and the Jabil Mobility acquisition without a matching rise in profit. Forward growth paths sit well BELOW even the equity CAGR because FY2025 (+1.2%) and 9M2026 (+3.4%) show the revenue engine has stalled.
historical_growth.notes: FY2022-FY2025 and FY2020-FY2025. Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - interest income: FY2020 248.8, FY2021 2,210.1, FY2022 1,662.0, FY2023 6,083.4, FY2024 3,550.5, FY2025 14,236.7. The FCF CAGRs are arithmetic artefacts of a near-zero FY2020 base and a working-capital-inflated FY2025 end point and carry no information; the five-year average owner FCF (~RMB5.5bn, before ~RMB0.5bn of lease payments) is the meaningful figure. SBC was nil before FY2025, so adjusted and reported FCF growth do not diverge on that account.

scenario_narratives.base: The 2026 profit collapse is part FX (a RMB702m loss in H1 on USD-denominated Apple-linked receivables as the RMB appreciated) and part real: structural/metal component revenue is shrinking as the largest customer changes casing materials, and assembly - the lowest-margin line - is now ~68% of revenue. Base treats the FX drag as mean-reverting to roughly zero but the mix erosion as permanent: EBITDA margin recovers from 4.7% in FY2026 to 5.3%, never regaining FY2024's 6.35% or even FY2025's 5.6%. Revenue grows 2.5-3% through FY2027 against a falling smartphone market, then 5-6% on new Apple categories made in Vietnam (smart home, foldable), NEV content per vehicle at a parent whose volume growth has slowed to single digits, and an AI-infrastructure line that stays small. Terminal owner-FCF margin ~1.6% of revenue.
scenario_narratives.bull: Management's 'structural recovery in smart terminals in 2027' arrives: a foldable iPhone and titanium-heavy designs restore component content, Apple smart-home devices add a new assembly line, the NVIDIA-certified liquid-cooling and 800VDC power products convert into real hyperscaler volume (the AI segment was only RMB0.75bn in H1 2026 and fell 10.6%), and NEV intelligent systems re-accelerate with BYD's overseas plants. Revenue compounds ~10-12% for three years and EBITDA margin returns to 6.2% - the FY2024 ex-FX level, not a new high. This needs several independent things to go right, which is why it carries the lowest weight.
scenario_narratives.bear: Apple's material shift (aluminium, later 3D-printed or glass casings) keeps stripping content, assembly share is diversified toward India and other vendors, global smartphone shipments fall double digits as memory costs rise (Counterpoint -13.9% for 2026), the RMB keeps appreciating so FX losses recur, and the captive NEV business stalls with BYD's domestic volumes. Revenue falls 5% in FY2027 and then crawls at 2%; EBITDA margin stays at 4.3-4.5%, leaving an EBIT margin near 1.3% and a terminal owner-FCF margin near 1%. The business survives - there is net cash and the terminal flow is positive, so the zero floor is not hit - but it earns well below its cost of capital on RMB34bn of equity.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A RMB180bn-revenue manufacturer earning a 2% net margin in a good year: value is decided by fifty basis points of margin, so the model builds the margin from components rather than capitalising a single FCF percentage. Two findings shape the result. First, the reported swing from net cash to 'net debt' in H1 2026 is a classification effect - RMB8.1bn of cash was moved into short-term finance products that the company's gearing ratio excludes; on an economic basis net cash is ~RMB6.3bn (about HKD3.3 per share) after the unpaid dividend. Second, a large share of the 2026 profit fall is FX: excluding the H1 FX loss, pre-tax profit fell ~30%, not 75%. The base case therefore assumes no margin recovery beyond FX normalising, and still values the business above the market price, because near-term depreciation and amortisation (~3.3% of revenue, including Jabil intangibles) exceed capex (~2.6%) and the market is capitalising trough-year earnings. The valuation is highly sensitive to the settled EBITDA margin: each 0.5 point moves base value by roughly a fifth to a quarter.
key_risks_to_valuation: Settled EBITDA margin: base 5.3% vs bear 4.5% vs bull 6.2% spans the whole valuation range; H1 2026 was 4.55% reported, 5.4% ex-FX, ~4.9% ex-FX and ex the jump in government grants
Single-customer concentration (~50% of revenue, Apple): casing-material changes and supply-chain diversification to India/Vietnam
FX: USD-denominated receivables against a RMB cost base; base assumes FX nets to zero, bear assumes it does not
Working-capital volatility: OCF swung from RMB18.8bn (FY2025) to RMB0.8bn (H1 2026); bills-payable float can unwind quickly if assembly volume falls
Government grants (RMB768m FY2025, RMB474m H1 2026) are inside EBITDA and are discretionary

Controlled company: ~66% owned by BYD Company, which is also the NEV segment's main customer and a counterparty for related-party purchases, sales and equipment leases; minority holders depend on transfer pricing they cannot see
China realisation risk is NOT haircut in this model; the screener applies the house 30% China markdown to upside separately

Unchanged-by-design items and what would move them: cash tax path (moves if the 15% preferential rates are not renewed after 2026-28); capex converging to D&A at 2.8% (moves if AI-infrastructure or overseas plant capex commitments step up); SBC at 0.07% of revenue (moves if further award-scheme tranches are granted)

prior_version.note: Legacy hand-built DCF, HKD at CNY->HKD 1.088; flat FCF margin 1.2/1.7/2.2% on FY2025 net-profit-derived FCF, 5-year horizon, WACC 11.5/10.5/9.5, terminal growth 2.5/3.0/3.5, weights 25/50/25. Prior growth paths: base 8/10/11/10/8, bull 15/18/20/17/14, bear 0/2/4/5/4.

reconciliation.drivers_changed: ALL prior driver paths are superseded, deliberately: the prior file has no component paths to carry over (it used one flat FCF margin), so this is a methodology rebuild rather than a silent re-judgment. Growth: the prior base 8-11% is cut to 2.5-6% because FY2026 is tracking +3%, NEV segment growth fell from +60% to +6.4% and AI-infrastructure revenue declined - the evidence touches the out-years, not only the guidance year. Margin: prior implied a flat 1.7% FCF margin; new base builds 1.3-1.4% in FY2026 rising to ~1.9% mid-horizon (D&A above capex) and settling ~1.6%. WACC: 10.0% uniform replaces 9.5/10.5/11.5. Weights: 30/50/20 replaces 25/50/25.

bridge.note: Residual, measured at the prior 25/50/25 weights: new scenario values weight to 27.46 vs 24.57 after the anchor steps. Negatives: growth cut from 8-11% to 2.5-6%, FY2026 margin reset to trough, terminal growth 3.0 -> 2.5. Positives that outweigh them: the prior base FCF was 60% of net profit (RMB2,109m) although D&A ex-leases (~RMB5.6-6.0bn) exceeds capex (~RMB4-5bn), so component-built FCF is higher than net profit rather than lower; 10-year horizon instead of 5; base WACC 10.5 -> 10.0. Per scenario (HKD): bear 14.82 -> 13.86, base 21.31 -> 26.31, bull 33.55 -> 43.35, of which FX alone is +8.1%.

realisation_haircut.basis: seeded from the screener PRC markdown, 2026-11-19

inputs.share_count_basis: 2,253,204,500 ordinary shares in issue (FY2025 AR line 1258; unchanged at 30 June 2026). Basic = diluted in the H1 2026 EPS note; shares bought for the 2025 share award scheme (RMB208m, FY2025) are treasury shares that vest back to employees, so the full issued count is the diluted count. Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026: cash and equivalents 5,474.8 + restricted deposits 2.8 + current finance products at FVTPL 8,261.4 = 13,738.9, less interest-bearing loans 7,079.9 = net cash 6,659.0. The company's own gearing ratio (+9.78%, 'net debt') excludes the finance products: H1 2026 investing outflow included RMB8,100m 'purchase of finance products' (cash flow statement), which moved cash into short-term wealth-management products rather than out of the business. The balance sheet did NOT flip to net debt in economic terms. Lease liabilities (1,768.4) excluded under lease treatment B. Declared-but-unpaid FY2025 final dividend (351.5) deducted in equity_bridge.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 owner FCF by the house formula (14,680.2 - 66.5 - 377.0). NOT a run-rate: FY2025 OCF of 18,768 was inflated by a ~RMB15bn receivables release in H1 2025, partly reversed in H1 2026 (OCF 844, FCF -1,649). TTM to June 2026 reported FCF = 5,169; five-year average FY2021-25 = 5,773. The forward build is from components and year-1 modelled owner FCF is ~RMB2.4-2.6bn (about 1.3-1.4% of revenue).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash flow statement line 4755 'Share-based payment compensation' RMB66,488k (first year of the 2025 share award scheme); H1 2026 RMB60.5m, i.e. ~RMB121m annualised = 0.07% of revenue, which anchors the forward path. No equity-award withholding taxes disclosed (0).
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1764, Yahoo CNYHKD=X regularMarketPrice at 2026-11-19 (same session as the price). All flows and per-share values are computed in CNY and converted to HKD at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD and comparable to current_price. No dual listing of BYD Electronic exists for a parity check (the parent 1211.HK/002594.SZ is a different security); direction check: 1 CNY buys more than 1 HKD, so HKD per-share values exceed CNY values. The prior version (2026-06-25) used 1.088; the RMB has appreciated ~8% against the USD-pegged HKD since, which is also the source of the company's 2026 FX losses.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: China 10-year government bond ~1.8-2.0% + equity risk premium incl. China country/governance risk ~6.5% x beta ~1.2 (cyclical, low-margin EMS with one dominant customer) = ~9.7-10%; negligible net debt so WACC ~ cost of equity. 10.0% used in ALL scenarios: risk lives in the scenario flows and weights (adaptations 7f), not in per-scenario discount rates. The prior version used 9.5/10.5/11.5 by scenario, which charged risk twice.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment B (leases as operating cost): total lease payments (FY2025 RMB588.8m, H1 2026 RMB293.2m, financing section, principal+interest) charged at 0.33% of revenue via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (1,768.4 at 30 June 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt; da_pct_path is PP&E depreciation + intangible amortisation only, EXCLUDING right-of-use depreciation (H1 2026: 2,538.7 + 464.3 = 3,003.0; ROU 294.4 excluded).
inputs.nci_treatment: No non-controlling interest: profit is 100% attributable to owners of the parent (H1 2026 income statement). No NCI deduction.
inputs.china_note: No model-side China realisation haircut is applied: dcf-methods prescribes none, and the house China markdown (CNY/RMB reporters cut 30%) is applied screener-side to produce 'Adj. upside'. China/governance/related-party risk enters here only through the CNY-built WACC's risk premium and the scenario weights. Related-party exposure is material: the NEV segment (~16% of revenue) is largely captive to parent BYD Company, which controls ~66% of the shares.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, with the non-US adaptations (CNY flows / HKD quote, lease treatment B, SBC near-zero). Reason: BYD Electronic is an operating EMS manufacturer whose value is a free-cash-flow stream; it is not a financial, REIT or holdco. Same model family as the prior (2026-06-25) legacy hand-built DCF, but that version capitalised a flat 1.2-2.2% FCF margin on a 5-year horizon with per-scenario WACCs; this version rebuilds margins from components, so prior and new are comparable in kind but not line-by-line (see reconciliation). ANCHORS: price and FX 2026-11-19; balance sheet and share count 30 June 2026 interim (latest full balance sheet; Q3 2026 figures are P&L headlines only). FY0 = FY2025 (last audited year); year 1 = FY2026, judged from 9M2026 actuals (revenue RMB127.46bn +3.4%, net profit RMB963m -69.3%); year 1 is discounted a full period although ~10.5 months have elapsed - mildly conservative. EBITDA definition used for ebitda_margin_path: profit before tax + finance costs - interest income + total D&A (post-IFRS-16), INCLUDING FX gains/losses and government grants: FY2024 6.35%, FY2025 5.61% (3,921.3 + 370.3 - 377.0 + 6,161.4 = 10,076), H1 2026 4.55% (480.8 + 128.1 - 161.9 + 3,297.4 = 3,744). FX: net FX gain 331 (FY2024), loss 213 (FY2025), loss 702 (H1 2026); ex-FX EBITDA margin 6.2% / 5.7% / 5.4%. H1 2026 also carried government grants of 474 vs 54 in H1 2025; without the increment the ex-FX margin is ~4.9%. INTEREST: interest income (377 FY2025) is excluded from the flows by construction (EBITDA is pre-interest) and its source assets - cash and finance products - are in the bridge; fair-value gains on finance products inside 'other income and gains' are not separately disclosed in the interim and are left in EBITDA (small). BUYBACKS: RMB208m in FY2025 funded the share award scheme, zero in H1 2026; the flat count is therefore funded. CALIBRATION: FY2025 modelled EBIT = 10,076 - 66 - 589 - 5,590 = 3,831; at 15% tax NOPAT 3,256 vs reported net profit 3,514.6 (reported effective tax 10.4%, net interest ~0) - ties within tax noise. WORKING CAPITAL: inventories 20.9bn + trade receivables 17.2bn - trade and bills payables 27.7bn = ~10.5bn net, ~6% of revenue; wc_capture -4% (growth consumes cash), below the balance-sheet ratio because bills-payable float has historically scaled with assembly volume.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 FY2026 +2.5%: 9M2026 revenue +3.4% with Q4 facing a weak smartphone market. Y2 +3%: Counterpoint's 2026-27 smartphone outlook is negative; NEV segment growing mid-single digits. Y3-Y6 5-6%: new-category Apple work (smart home, foldable), NEV content per vehicle and a small AI-infrastructure contribution. Fades to 3%.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 4.7% reflects H1 at 4.55% including a RMB702m FX loss, with Q3 better (Q3 net profit ~RMB537m vs H1 426m). Settles at 5.3%: roughly the H1 2026 ex-FX level (5.4%), i.e. FX nets to about zero over time but the FY2024 margin (6.35%) is NOT regained - the component-mix erosion is treated as permanent.
base.da_capex_rationale: D&A ex right-of-use: FY2025 ~3.1%, H1 2026 annualising ~3.3% of FY revenue, of which ~RMB0.93bn/yr is amortisation of Jabil-acquired intangibles that runs off by ~2029 (RMB2.3bn left at June 2026). Capex FY2021-25 averaged ~RMB3.8bn; H1 2026 RMB2.5bn. Capex converges to D&A at 2.8% so the terminal flow carries no depreciation-over-capex windfall.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax paid / PBT: 13% FY2024, 18% FY2025. Main subsidiaries hold 15% high-tech / western-development rates through 2026-2028; ramped to 18% for partial reversion toward the 25% statutory rate and Pillar Two.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the 15% house default and the prior 25%): ~50% of revenue rests on one customer whose design choices are already cutting content, and 9M2026 profit fell 69% while revenue grew - the deterioration is observed, not hypothetical. Base 50%: FX-neutral margins hold near the H1 2026 underlying level. Bull 20% (below the 35% default and the prior 25%): it needs a foldable/titanium content recovery, an AI-infrastructure ramp that has so far gone backwards, and an NEV re-acceleration to coincide.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
